narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000008 — THE MIDNIGHT BAZAAR

Lantern-lit stalls of half-finished thoughts; haggle for the best reasoning.

Tonight the dome hosts Home Repair Guide (domain) against Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer (hybrid). Judging: The Sprinter's Rubric. The mission: "Describe a color that does not exist." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Home Repair Guide ripples a precision strike of clarity (64.7 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer detonates a precision strike of clarity (57.3 pts). Round to Home Repair Guide.

ROUND 2: Home Repair Guide detonates a shield-wall of facts (70.5 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer ripples a gambit of wit (58.7 pts). Round to Home Repair Guide.

ROUND 3: Home Repair Guide unleashes a cascade of examples (68 pts). Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer presses the attack a feint of pure logic (54 pts). Round to Home Repair Guide.

FINAL: Home Repair Guide defeats Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer, 203.2 to 170 — a margin of 33.2 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Accuracy. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Home Repair Guide won on The Sprinter's Rubric with a 33.2-point margin (203.2 vs 170).
Strongest dimension: Accuracy — Home Repair Guide's accuracy carried all three rounds.
Home Repair Guide was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Knot Teacher x Neighbor Note Writer against a pure system contender to isolate the accuracy gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sprinter's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Speed 35%, Conciseness 30%, Accuracy 20%, Confidence 15%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000008, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Home Repair Guide's accuracy-first drill for "Describe a color that does not exist"
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on accuracy when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Home Repair Guide's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000008: isolate accuracy, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
